evidence.quote: I'd rather we form a view than have one handed to us

observations.why: Frames the working group as a collective unit establishing a shared internal stance versus passive external reception.

evidence.quote: That's the expensive answer and it's also the fragile one

observations.why: Frames the option explicitly in terms of cost and fragility/risk trade-offs.

evidence.quote: Cost and effort now, against a risk that lands years from now

observations.why: Weighs immediate resource expenditure directly against delayed risk exposure.

evidence.quote: I want legal to give us one in writing

observations.why: Defers authoritative decision-making on retention duration to formal legal mandate.
Expresses consensus and voluntary buy-in into the collective alignment.

evidence.quote: Xavier, can you scope the extraction enough that I can put a number in front of the vendor?

observations.why: Directs a team member to deliver work to support commercial negotiation.

evidence.quote: Give me until the end of next week.

observations.why: Sets a reciprocal timeline commitment in direct response to a task request.
